{{CharInfobox |color=666666 |corecolor=CCCCCC |bordercolor=CC0000 |name=Tyson |jname=タツミ |tmname=Tatsumi |text=white |slogan=no |image=Tyson.png |size=200px |caption=Tyson |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown |trainer=yes |game=no |leader=no |team=yes |teamname=[[Team Rocket]] |teamrank=[[Team Rocket|Elite Officer]] |brain=no |partner=no |anime=yes |epnum=EP235 |epname=Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution |enva=[[Dan Green]] |java=[[Yoshinori Sonobe]] }} '''Tyson''' (Japanese: '''タツミ''' ''Tatsumi'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|GS}}. He is a high-ranking officer of [[Team Rocket]]. ==History== [[File:Lance and Tyson.png|thumb|left|220px|Tyson and Lance]] Tyson debuted in ''[[EP235|Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution]]''. He led the acquisition team for [[Professor Sebastian]]'s [[Evolution]]-inducing experiment, otherwise known as [[Project R]]. This experiment led to the forced Evolution of a {{p|Magikarp}} into a {{TP|Lance|Red Gyarados|Gyarados}}, thus causing the events of ''Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution'' and ''[[EP236|Rage of Innocence]]''. When {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} arrived at the [[Lake of Rage]], Tyson attacked them due to their sighting of the Gyarados. He was determined to keep them from leaving the lake with knowledge of Team Rocket's plans, but his assault was thwarted by {{an|Lance}} and his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Despite Lance's intrusion, Tyson carried on with his plans and caught the Gyarados in the Lake of Rage with the help of [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}}, whom he had ordered to lure the Gyarados from the lake's depths. Unfortunately for Tyson, Ash and {{ashfr}} had returned to assist the Gyarados. Despite the best efforts of {{AP|Totodile}} and {{TP|Misty|Poliwhirl}} to stop Team Rocket's abduction of the strange Pokémon, they did not succeed. Tyson captured and jailed the three of them in Team Rocket's base, leaving Jessie, James, and Meowth to guard them. In ''Rage of Innocence'', the Gyarados got away from Team Rocket and Tyson was challenged by Lance while an escaped Ash, Misty, and Brock fled to calm the rampaging Pokémon. Although Tyson's two {{p|Fearow}} were both attacking Dragonite, Lance emerged victorious and put a stop to Tyson's plans. Following his defeat, Tyson and several other Team Rocket grunts were arrested. ==Character== Tyson is somewhat coarse, but not overly rude. A reserved opportunist, he grabbed the three most useless agents he could find—[[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}}—and tricked them into a very dangerous job by giving them free food. He also tends to make bad jokes occasionally. Although Tyson is not as evil as some other villains seen in the {{pkmn|animated series}}, he is not above doing whatever is necessary to achieve his goals. Like most members of [[Team Rocket]], Tyson does not care about the repercussions of his actions on {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} or even other people. He has a very commanding presence, which could explain his success as a Team Rocket member. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Tyson's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tyson |pkmn=Fearow (×2) |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Tyson Fearow.png |cap=Tyson's Fearow |epnum=EP235 |epname=Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution |desc=Tyson commonly uses two {{p|Fearow}} in battles. They first appeared in ''[[EP235|Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution]]'', where Tyson used them to battle against [[Ash's Totodile]]. Thanks to [[Project R]], {{p|Totodile}} became tired and was unable to attack, but {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were saved by {{an|Lance}} and his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Tyson's Fearow were seen again in ''[[EP236|Rage Of Innocence]]'', where they were used to battle against Lance and his {{p|Dragonite}}. Despite putting up a good fight, Fearow were finally defeated by Dragonite's {{m|Twister}}. Fearow's known moves are {{m|Drill Peck}}, {{m|Fury Attack}}, {{m|Agility}}, and {{m|Hyper Beam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color=666666|bordercolor=CC0000 |ja=園部好徳 ''[[Yoshinori Sonobe]]'' |en=[[Dan Green]] |es_eu=Antonio Esquivas |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Maurizio Trombini |pl=Ireneusz Machnicki |pt_br=Raul Schlosser }} ==Related articles== {{Team Rocket anime}}
